topic: Why having fewer options makes you happier with your choices

script.title: Paradox of Choice: Why Less Options Make You Happier
script.hook: Why does having more choices secretly ruin your decisions?

scenes.text: Why does having more choices secretly ruin your decisions?
When you are faced with dozens of options, your brain feels overloaded.
Psychologists call this phenomenon the paradox of choice.

motion_action.result_headline: Overabundance of options leads to regret and anxiety

scenes.text: In a famous supermarket experiment, displays with twenty four jams attracted buyers.
But when researchers reduced the display to just six jams, sales skyrocketed.
Every extra option forces you to compare hypothetical outcomes.
This creates opportunity cost anxiety, making you constantly second guess yourself.

motion_action.headline: BUYER REGRET
motion_action.subtext: The fear of missing out on a better choice

scenes.text: To make better decisions faster, intentionally limit your options.

motion_action.title: DECISION STRATEGY
motion_action.highlight_text: Fewer options lead to higher satisfaction

scenes.text: You will instantly feel more confident in whatever you pick.

script.description:
Discover why having more choices secretly ruins your decisions and leads to regret. Learn how choice overload affects brain psychology and decision making. Simplify your choices to boost overall happiness.
